message:
The other day, as I was organizing the garage (you know, the place where old bikes go to die), I stumbled upon a stash of old candles and batteries I had forgotten about. With a storm brewing outside, I felt a small sense of victory—no more rummaging through drawers during a power outage like a frantic raccoon! 

It’s funny how a little bit of prep can make a big difference. I even found a few matches tucked away in an old toolbox, which I’m sure will come in handy when the lights flicker out.

Have you had any small wins in your own prep journey? I'd love to hear your tips!
